title: Peroxide dianion
hints: Begin from the O₂ π* occupancy of two.
Add two electrons to complete the pair.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Two extra electrons fill the π* pair, lowering order from 2 to 1 and pairing all electrons.
statement:
What are the bond order and magnetic behavior of $\ce{O2^2-}$ in this model?

[_]{a}

explanations: The π* pair is now fully occupied.
The filled π* pair contains no singles.
The order falls when two antibonding electrons are added.
Adding antibonding electrons weakens the order.
